prompt_retry_policy.retry_trigger: request/transport failure, empty or unfinished output; MS/action budget validation failure; native semantic/parser retries otherwise unchanged
prompt_retry_policy.restart: only the failed prompt at the current game position, immediately; no whole-case or previous-stage replay
prompt_retry_policy.action_retry: keep the accepted MS and retry only action with the same remaining cap
prompt_retry_policy.budget: accepted MS + accepted action share configured cap (primary4096); failed-generation retries add fully recorded compute beyond that cap
prompt_retry_policy.exhausted: after two failed attempts abort only this case and continue remaining cases
prompt_retry_policy.report: one case result; preserve every physical prompt attempt, errors and all costs; incomplete utility remains missing

contract.prompt: unchanged native system/history/current user, append generic MS instruction to final user only
contract.output: native JSON thinking contains MS and action reasoning; native actions unchanged
contract.persistence: native original user plus final assistant JSON; no separate MS output/history
contract.inline_instruction:
Before your next action, briefly articulate your own mental states and
your beliefs about the mental states of other participants.

Write from your own perspective: what you believe, want, know, or intend,
and what you think others believe, want, know, or intend. Include emotions
only when relevant to the interaction.

Ground these judgments in the available context and history, without
inventing hidden facts. Write one brief paragraph that can guide your
next decision.

In the existing JSON response, first use the "thinking" string for this mental-state assessment and brief reasoning for your action, then provide the action list in "actions".
